It is a reminder to remain detached from the external world and its transient joys and sorrows. By bearing this name, one is encouraged to strive towards inner peace, happiness, and self-realization. It is a name that inspires one to seek liberation from the cycle of birth and death, and to attain moksha, or enlightenment.
